# A small check: the demo song's lyrics in the night sky, a few frames of a line change, and the settings screen.
# Run it: gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref <branch> -f version=26.3 -f script=.github/checks/example.txt
# One test hook command per line (see DevTestHook.java); `sleep <s>` waits, `wait <log text>` waits for the log.
# Lines next to each other go to the game together; a sleep sends them.

# A clear night that stays night, looking a little above the horizon
cmd weather clear
cmd time set midnight
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
look 0 -20
sleep 8
where
shot example-night

# The arc layout, caught as the next line starts
set layout ARC
sleep 2
burstat example-arc 6 400
wait burst example-arc wrote

# Jump to a known line and read where the song is
seek 20
sleep 3
where
shot example-seek

# The settings screen, first tab
gui 0
sleep 4
shot example-settings
close
